name: vscode-mcp-bridge
description: Grok Code live bridge — exposes the editor to Grok (and other MCP clients) over localhost HTTP. Same layout & wire protocol.

vscodeMcpBridge.port.description: Local HTTP port for the Grok Code bridge (127.0.0.1 only).

vscodeMcpBridge.host.description: Host interface to bind. Keep 127.0.0.1 for safety.

vscodeMcpBridge.autoStart.description: Start the Grok Code bridge automatically when the editor launches.

vscodeMcpBridge.token.description: Optional shared secret. If empty, a random token is generated per workspace and persisted.

vscodeMcpBridge.autoRegisterMcp.description: When true, write grok-code MCP server entries into ~/.grok/config.toml and Claude Desktop config (if present).

vscodeMcpBridge.mcpServerPath.description: Absolute path to mcp-server/dist/index.js for auto-register. Empty = auto-detect near the extension.
